text:
In an old, inefficient country,

something like Spain between two

civil wars, in a town by the sea,

to own a house and a little land

and no memories. To read nothing,

to suffer nothing, write nothing, pay no bills,

and live like a ruined nobleman

amid the ruins of my intelligence.

translation.title: A Happy Life
